job.name: s5_first_hello
job.prompt: A customer is just entering the pharmacy; the pharmacist behind the counter looks up first, makes warm eye contact and greets them first with a friendly smile and a small wave. The customer looks relieved. Walls and shelves have NO signs, posters or labels at all — shelves hold plain colored boxes without any markings.
job.meaning: не бойтесь здороваться первым — тепло, глядя человеку в глаза
